[RFCS.2.2] **A stream is read forward-only and single-pass.** A reader
processes atoms one at a time in order and never seeks backwards.

The stream **does** have an outer container — a `Stream` whose
`repeated Atom atoms = 1` makes the unit on the wire an outer frame
`[0x0A][varint len][Atom]` ([RFCS.19.1]). An implementer who emits atoms
without it is one level short.
